$comment: Canonical contract addresses on Arc. Source: https://docs.arc.io/arc/references/contract-addresses (checked 2026-09-18). Predeployed contracts share the same address on mainnet and testnet unless noted. USDC has NO wrapped version on Arc: the native balance (18 decimals) and the ERC-20 interface (6 decimals) are the SAME funds.

USDC.note: ERC-20 view over the native balance. Native gas accounting uses 18 decimals.

Memo.note: Predeploy. Attaches memo metadata to calls; emits Memo events with a sequential index.

Multicall3From.note: Predeploy. Batches calls like Multicall3 but preserves the original msg.sender via the CallFrom precompile.
